run_upload_to_wandbox: run the script to upload a C++ directory and main file to Wandbox for online compilation
run_strip_comments: run the strip_comments function to remove C and C++ comments from source code text
run_headers: run the headers function to recursively find all .hpp header files in a directory
run_upload_api: run the upload function to POST JSON data to the Wandbox compile API endpoint
review_main: review the main function that parses CLI args and orchestrates the Wandbox upload workflow
